findings.detail: The rejected twelve-case attempt used dataset-reviewer@example.invalid in its manifest and REVIEW files.
workflowdemo used an example.invalid repository URL and an unverified commit.

GitHub access was unavailable during the audit. The user explicitly accepted the recorded repository URL, commit and document hashes in the current Codex conversation; this is not represented as an independent GitHub verification.

resolutions: Unsupported placeholder cases were removed; only the evidence-backed VisionDemo status-filter case remains.
The current conversation identity conversation:user approved the four human-judgment steps.
The dataset was promoted to golden/frozen and a digest-bound reviewed evidence envelope was added.
The golden_dataset readiness gate now references the formal evidence by SHA-256.
remaining_limitation: The repository commit has not been independently reverified through an authenticated GitHub session.
